purpose: Bounded in-sample fitting diagnostic, not generalization or production model selection
selection_rule: Report final fixed-budget fits and predeclared learning-curve points; no best-checkpoint selection
limits: Same already train-fitted scaler and 39 features; no additional feature engineering
MLP starts from scratch with existing light widths and dropout
Balanced panel changes exposure and objective; not an isolated weighting ablation
Training metrics on a balanced panel are not natural-prevalence validation metrics
Tree and neural fits are not capacity-, update-, or time-matched
No model promotion, cloud training, hyperparameter search, or federated tree implementation
